scope: Exploratory actual complete captured caller and finite scan mechanisms; no validation cache; private application capture is not retained here. Accelerate classifications passed the tested oracle but the SDK does not guarantee IEEE NaN behavior.
compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin
notes: The measured alternatives.c includes ../../native/pack/src/adapter.c from its original .local/pack-ragged-next-native location. reference-adapter.c here freezes that exact included source.
SME requires a supported CPU and compiler; foreign-order or unaligned SME requests fall back to the exact NEON max scan.
Parallel dispatch results include synchronous task scheduling and joins. No custom persistent spin pool is used.
No production source was edited by these experiments.

measure_alternatives.py.txt retains the exact measured driver bytes. The original path in alternatives-results.json is .local/pack-ragged-next-native/measure_alternatives.py; restore that path when replaying so __file__ and its recorded hash retain their original meaning.

publication_normalization.note: Consumer labels, artifact paths and machine-specific origins normalized for public publication. Historical timings, measured payload bytes and original source digests retain their captured meaning; normalized source/archive bytes have their own publication hashes.
